attorneys: Maurice F. Hanning and J. King Rosendale for appellant., Charles C. Redmond for appellee., Jack P. F. Gremillion, Attorney General of' Louisiana, filed a brief for the State of Louisiana, as amicus curiae, in support of appellant.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is -granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the .papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for certiorari, certiorari is denied.

Mr. Justice Stewart took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
